response.sql:
WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
project_excesses AS (
  SELECT project_id,
         funding_source,
         ratio,
         ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM project_excesses
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is missing when boxz is zero or all per-record ratios for a project are missing; such projects are excluded from the above-average result because their excess is not positive.
